## First word to filename or/and title

You can use **first word** in first line to a filename of a file text or just a title of prompt etc. 

If you need more than one word to filename or title, use **"_"** to space between of words.

### first_word_is_filename
Set to "True" to node identify that first word in prompt is to filename.

### ignore_start_number_label
Set to **"True"** to return prompt without the prefix number, if exist, of sinippet.

## Input_index_split

If inside of hidden snippet text is a array format (spliting with ";"), you must inform the index of array item. 
Ex: "gentle smile;micro smile;open smile" index 0 is "gentle smile", index 1 is "micro smile".
